describes: packages/plugin/annotation: tools in the hub, the five pointer handlers as sample sequences, click placement, stamps, the file-picker port, the ghost and behaviors.

cases.name: init-registers-the-tools
cases.covers: init registers every resolved tool with the hub (drag-create tools touchDirect, text-select tools skipped without a selection plugin) and seeds their defaults; a config tool is added and a built-in configured.

cases.name: init-with-selection
cases.covers: With a selection plugin the markup and text-edit tools register too.

cases.name: a-bad-config-tool-fails-the-capability
cases.covers: A config tool whose defaults its kind does not take makes the capability throw at construction.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] tool 'square' does not support default 'fontSize' for 'square'

cases.name: edit-gestures
cases.covers: Under the pointer tool the edit handler claims over an annotation: hover sets the cursor claim and the hover state, a press selects and arms a move, moves resolve against the home page (the projected point, then the page hit), and the up commits one geometry patch. A press on empty space deselects (shift keeps it for the marquee) and declines.

cases.name: edit-gesture-cancel-and-off-page-up
cases.covers: An aborted gesture replays back to its down point and closes there (no net change); an up off every page still closes the gesture at the last point.

cases.name: touch-consent
cases.covers: claimsTouch: over the selection’s chrome or a selected, movable body a finger owns the gesture; over an unselected body it scrolls. A touch press grabs with the widened zones.

cases.name: double-click-edits-free-text
cases.covers: A double-click over a free-text box enters text edit and captures; over another kind it falls through to a normal press. While editing, a press outside commits the edit and is consumed on empty space.

cases.name: marquee-selects
cases.covers: On empty space the marquee handler captures; it starts the core’s marquee only past 4px of viewport travel, grows it along the home page, and commits a selection on up. A shift marquee is additive; a cancel clears the draft; a press off every page declines.

cases.name: draw-shapes
cases.covers: Under a draw tool the draw handler captures: a drag sizes the shape and commits on up (released off-page it commits at the last point); a bare click commits the tool’s click-create default; the DOWN sample’s rotation feeds upright. Without create authority nothing drafts.

cases.name: draw-without-authority
cases.covers: createPointer is inert without create authority: no draft, no engine call.

cases.name: ink-strokes-group
cases.covers: An ink tool with a grouping window buffers strokes: a stroke started on the same page inside the window extends the draft, the window’s timer commits it, a stroke on another page flushes the buffer first, a tool change flushes it, and a cancel drops it.

cases.name: grab-reach-follows-the-scale
cases.covers: The handle and knob reach is half the hit size over the page scale, doubled for touch, and the knob offset shrinks with the scale: probes just inside and outside both at scale 2, a zero scale and a NaN scale (both read as 1).

cases.name: page-box-of-an-offset-crop
cases.covers: On a page whose crop starts off the origin (10, 20 to 410, 520) the page box is 400 x 500: it decides where the rotate knob flips or clamps, and where a note placed in the corner is clamped.

cases.name: chrome-follows-the-view
cases.covers: chrome takes the view from a rotation alone (a noRotate note counter-rotates), recomputes when only the scale changes, and draws the rotate guides during a rotate gesture.

cases.name: handlers-outrank-a-lower-handler
cases.covers: The place (95), draw (55) and marquee (50) handlers each take the press ahead of a scripted handler at priority 25 that would also claim it.

cases.name: handlers-wake-only-for-their-tags
cases.covers: A tool that enables only annotation-edit wakes neither the place handler (a note subtype still places nothing) nor the marquee (a drag on empty space selects nothing).

cases.name: edit-press-inside-the-touch-reach-only
cases.covers: A mouse press 18px diagonally off a selected square’s corner handle is outside the mouse reach (12px) and inside the touch reach (24px): it deselects rather than starting a resize.

cases.name: marquee-starts-at-exactly-4px
cases.covers: The marquee starts at 4px of viewport travel, not past it, measured as a distance from the press: once along x, once along y.

cases.name: hover-drives-only-a-multi-click-draft
cases.covers: Hover feeds the draft only for a poly or callout mid-creation: not for a polygon or callout tool before its first click, and not for an ink stroke waiting in its grouping window. An ink tool without a window commits on up and schedules nothing.

cases.name: ink-cancel-inside-the-grouping-window
cases.covers: A cancel while an ink group is still inside its grouping window clears the window’s timer, so the buffered stroke never commits. Only a down that is not an ink down leaves the window open for the cancel to meet: re-registering the active tool id as a square does that without a tool change.

cases.name: poly-and-callout-clicks
cases.covers: Poly tools take vertices by click, ignore drags, preview on hover and finish on a double-click; a callout advances tip, knee, box by click with a hover preview. A cancel drops the draft; a tool change resets the gesture state.

cases.name: note-placement-and-ghost
cases.covers: The note tool: hover paints the fixed 20x20 footprint ghost (vector, through pageItems), a press clears it (the ghost handler declines), and the place handler creates the note centred on the click, selected once committed. Off-page hover clears the ghost; a refused create reports to console.error.

cases.name: click-create-ghosts
cases.covers: ghostHoverAt for a click-create tool paints its default geometry (page-clamped); a tool without a footprint policy, an unknown tool, a page without a crop, and a tool without a click policy clear it. setPlacementPreview clamps a box to the page; clearPlacementPreview clears.

cases.name: stamp-prompt-through-the-file-picker
cases.covers: The stamp tool’s prompt source asks the installed file-picker port (the request carries the tool, its subtype, the accept filter and the click), then sniffs the picked bytes and places the stamp at their intrinsic size, fit to the page and selected. A cancel drops it; a rejection reports; a tool change while the picker is open expires the click; junk bytes report; with no provider the click is declined.

args: [annotation] stamp source must be PNG, JPEG, or single-page PDF bytes

cases.name: attachment-placement
cases.covers: The attachment tool picks the spot first and the file second: the picked file embeds at the click as a file-attachment with the tool’s icon and flags; a refused create reports.

cases.name: armed-stamps
cases.covers: armStamp validates the bytes, keeps the preview (the source for rasters, an explicit one for PDF, none otherwise), sizes from the intrinsic pixels or an override or a target width, bumps the arm epoch and activates the stamp tool. Hover draws the image ghost; each click places a stamp; leaving the stamp family disarms. Junk bytes reject.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] stamp source must be PNG, JPEG, or single-page PDF bytes

cases.name: armed-stamps-need-the-stamp-tag
cases.covers: armStamp activates the stamp tool, and the tool-change callback disarms unless the active tool enables annotation-stamp; the built-in stamp tool does not (it enables annotation-place), so only a stamp tool configured with the legacy tag keeps the payload. Armed: hover draws the image ghost, a click places it, a page without a crop declines, the preview is readable; leaving the family disarms.

$error.name: TypeError
$error.message: Cannot destructure property 'data' of 'source' as it is null.

cases.name: fixed-bytes-stamp-tool
cases.covers: registerTool at runtime: a stamp preset with fixed bytes places on click with no picker; an upright tool counter-rotates on a rotated page. The unregister removes it (the hub’s tool too); a same-id registration replaces; an invalid one throws.

args: [annotation] stamp source must be PNG, JPEG, or single-page PDF bytes

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] tool 'bad' does not support default 'fontSize' for 'square'

cases.name: behaviors-make-annotations-inert
cases.covers: A registered behavior that matches and is engaged makes its annotations hit-test inert (hit, cursor, gestures) and prunes them from the selection on a tool change; behaviorFor returns it. Unregistering restores them.

cases.name: placement-declines
cases.covers: placeAt with nothing armed declines for a tool that is neither a stamp nor an icon kind and for an unregistered active tool; placeArmedStamp with nothing armed declines.
